summary.text: Jim DeSana (listed by Ballotpedia as James DeSana) is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 29 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a farmer by profession.

paragraphs.text: James DeSana lives in Ash Township, Michigan, and earned a B.S. in business administration and management from the University of Detroit Mercy.
His career experience includes working as a farmer, an NCAA baseball umpire, and a manufacturer's representative with U.S. Rivet Supply.
DeSana assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
He served on the Education Committee in 2023-2024 and is assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in 2025-2026.
